test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question: Noise can be differentiated from other pollutants because:

options.text: it does not impact the productivity of the workers in industries
it is not detrimental to our health in any way
it is prevalent only in the urban areas of the country
it is regarded as a small irritant which may be easily dismissed

solution:
The correct answer is "**it is regarded as a small irritant which may be easily dismissed**"
